messages.author: ea6b1cd9e71466ee
messages.subject: Shiny Server code output
parts:
Hey,

When I run my app on my local machine, there are a handful of print statements that output to the console so I can kind of monitor what the app is doing while it's happening.

When I'm running the app on Shiny Server, is there any way for me to view this output? It would be very helpful for troubleshooting.

Thanks.

messages.author: 9711d30301c32133
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server code output
parts:
Hi Blake,

Unfortunately, we don't have that implemented just yet, though that is on our todo list.

There is one hack that I'm aware of, however. The Shiny application's stderr is made available in a file in /var/log/shiny-server/. There may be a few of these files in there, so you can use a command like `ls -lrt /var/log/shiny-server` to sort by time and find the most recent file. Because this is only stderr, you won't get your normal `print` statements, but you will get `message` and `warning` calls (along with stop(), though that wouldn't be too useful for debugging, I imagine).

Again, we eventually hope to expose the normal stdout stream somewhere to make this a bit easier, but hopefully this will tide you over.

Jeff
